text: What is Mate Ma'a Tonga? Tonga's rugby league team nickname. Mate Ma'a Tonga is the national rugby league team of Tonga, a Pacific Island nation, and the name used for it in the Rugby League World Cup 2026. The team plays New Zealand in the first semi-final of the tournament.. The first semi-final of the 2026 Rugby League World Cup, New Zealand vs Tonga, is being broadcast, and Tonga's unbeaten run has made the match a focus for viewers.. Tonga has won all three of its group matches at the 2026 Rugby League World Cup. Its 20-18 victory over Samoa was decided late in the game, after Tonga had led 14-4 and then trailed before coming back. Rob Toia was singled out for a decisive contribution in that match. Tonga's form in recent meetings with New Zealand is a key part of the story. Tonga beat New Zealand 25-14 in a Pacific Championships match two years ago, which took them to their first-ever elite tournament final. In the 2017 World Cup, Tonga beat New Zealand 28-22 in the group stage and went on to the semi-finals. For American viewers, Premier Sports is showing the tournament in the USA and offers every game for a one-off fee of $25. New Zealand and Australia have free coverage through ThreeNow and 7plus, respectively.
